# Judith Chapter 5 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Judith 5 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/JDT_005_page_001.jpg

---

**5:1** And it-was-reported to Holofernes, the-chief commander of-the Assyrian force, that the-sons of Israel had-prepared-for-war and had-closed the-mountain passes and had-fortified all-the tops of-the high hills and had-placed obstacles in-the plains.

**5:2** And he-was-exceedingly-enraged, and he-called all-the rulers of Moab and the-generals of Ammon and all-the governors of-the seacoast

**5:3** and he-said to them: "Tell me, you-sons of Canaan, who is this people that-dwells in-the hill-country? And what are the-cities which they-inhabit? And how large is their-army? And where is their-power and their-strength? And who has-stood-up as-king over them, leading their-force?

**5:4** And why have they-turned-their-backs, [being] the-only ones among all the-ones dwelling in-the west, not coming-out to-meet me?"

**5:5** And Achior, the-ruler of all-the sons of Ammon, said to him: "Let my lord now hear a word from-the mouth of his-servant, and I-will-tell-the-truth to-you concerning this people that-dwells near-to-you, and no lie shall-come-out from my mouth.

**5:6** This people is from-the seed of-the Chaldeans.

**5:7** And they-sojourned formerly in Mesopotamia, because they-were-not-willing to-follow the-gods of their-fathers who were in-the land of-the Chaldeans.

**5:8** And they-departed from-the way of their-fathers and they-worshiped the-God of-Heaven, the-God whom they-came-to-know; and their-fathers cast them out from-before the-face of their-gods, and they-fled into Mesopotamia and they-sojourned there many days.

**5:9** And their-God commanded them to-go-out from their-dwelling-place and to-journey into-the land of Canaan, and they-dwelt there and they-were-filled with gold and silver and with very-much livestock.

**5:10** And they-went-down into Egypt, because a famine covered-over all-the face of-the land of Canaan, and they-sojourned there until they-became-great. And they-became there a multitude — there-was-no-numbering of their-host —

**5:11** and the-king of Egypt rose-up against them and outwitted them with-labor and with making-of-bricks, and humbled them and made them into slaves.

**5:12** And they-cried-out to their-God, and he-struck the-whole land of Egypt with plagues of-no-healing. And-so the-Egyptians drove them out from-before their-face.

**5:13** And God dried-up the-Red-Sea before them,

**5:14** and he-led them in-the way of Sinai and Kadesh-Barnea, and they-cast-out all-the ones inhabiting the-desert.

**5:15** And they-dwelt in-the land of-the Amorites and they-utterly-destroyed by their-strength all-the ones dwelling in Heshbon, and having-crossed over the-Jordan they-took-possession of all-the hill-country.

**5:16** And they-drove-out before them the-Canaanite and the-Perizzite and the-Jebusite and the-Shechemite and all-the Girgashites, and they-dwelt in it many days.

**5:17** And as-long-as they-did-not-sin before their-God they-prospered, because a God hating iniquity is with them.

**5:18** But when they-went-away from-the way which he-appointed for them, they-were-utterly-destroyed in many battles very-greatly and they-were-led-captive into a land not-their-own; and the-temple of their-God was-razed-to-the-ground, and their-cities were-seized by their-enemies.

**5:19** And now they-have-turned and have-turned-back to their-God, and they-have-come-up from-the scattering-places where they-had-been-scattered, and they-have-taken-possession of Jerusalem where their-sanctuary is, and they-have-settled in-the hill-country, because it-was-desolate.

**5:20** And now, my lord and master, if there-is any-error in this people, and they-are-sinning against their-God, and we-observe that-stumbling-block of-theirs, we-will-go-up and we-will-fight-against them.

**5:21** But if there-is no iniquity in their-nation, let my lord now pass-them-by, lest their-Lord defend them and their-God be on their-side, and we-become a reproach before all-the earth."

**5:22** And when Achior had-ceased speaking all these words, all-the people who-were-standing around the-tent murmured, and the-great-ones of Holofernes and all-the ones dwelling beside-the-sea and in Moab said that he-should-be-cut-to-pieces.

**5:23** "For we-will-not-be-afraid of-the sons of Israel, because behold, they-are a people having-no strength and no power for-battle-array of great strength.

**5:24** Therefore let-us go-up, and they-will-become prey to-devour for all your army, Lord Holofernes."
